summary: Frontend regression test after downgrading date-fns 4.1.0 -> 3.6.0 (for react-day-picker@8.10.1 peer-dep compatibility, no --legacy-peer-deps needed for Render build) and adding engines.node=20. All critical flows verified via Playwright on the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Zero console errors, zero page errors, all pages render, dates display correctly.

issues: Only 2 of 6 settings tabs expose data-testid (tab-admins, tab-telegram). Missing: tab-general (Общие), tab-mailing (Рассылки), tab-email (Email), tab-security (Безопасность). Functionality unaffected — click via role='tab' works — but hurts test automation coverage.

action_items: OPTIONAL: add data-testid to remaining Settings tabs (tab-general, tab-mailing, tab-email, tab-security) for test parity with tab-admins/tab-telegram.

Render deployment for frontend should now be unblocked — date-fns@3.6.0 resolves peer-dep conflict with react-day-picker@8.10.1 without --legacy-peer-deps; engines.node ^20 documented in package.json.
critical_code_review_comments: date-fns is NOT imported anywhere in /app/frontend/src (grep confirmed empty). Downgrade is safe: only react-day-picker (calendar) and internal transitives consume it. StatusBadge.jsx uses native Date.toLocaleString (verified in review request). No functional regression possible from this dependency change.
frontend/.env: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly points to production preview URL — no hardcoded backend URLs in src (per review request scope, not exhaustively re-audited).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded 10 demo organizations from backend seed_data.py
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite for date-fns 3.6.0 downgrade: (1) Login admin@crm.ru/Admin123! via [data-testid=login-*] -> dashboard renders. (2) All 10 sidebar items [data-testid=nav-<Russian label>] navigate without white screens. Note: nav testids use RUSSIAN labels (nav-Организации, nav-Настройки), NOT english slugs. (3) [data-testid=org-name-<id>] click opens [data-testid=org-drawer] with 4 tabs [tab-info, tab-messages, tab-changes, tab-actions]. (4) Dates render as DD.MM.YYYY, HH:MM (e.g. '11.07.2026, 17:19') via native Date.toLocaleString — not date-fns. (5) Settings has only tab-admins + tab-telegram data-testids; other tabs accessible via role=tab name=<label>. Zero console errors observed.

Sidebar navigation: Главная/Организации/Импорт/Очередь/Шаблоны/Ответы/Дубли/Экспорт/Журнал/Настройки all mount OK (body length > 4500 chars each; no error boundary)
